bio.text: Leo Biasiucci, a Republican, has represented District 30 in the Arizona House of Representatives since January 9, 2023, and served as House majority leader from 2023 to January 2025.
He is not running for re-election to the House and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the Arizona State Senate seat from District 30.

Biasiucci earned a B.S. in business administration and management from the University of Arizona in 2005; his career experience includes owning Mohave Traffic Survival School and working as a claims analyst with GEICO and a financial auditor with GE Capital.
